how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for MDU Rohtak Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.mdurohtak.ac.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.

Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application form is 04-08-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification required for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Medical Biotechnology or any Life Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Field Investigator post in Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Field Investigator post will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the MDU Rohtak Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Maharshi Dayanand University Rohtak: https://www.mdurohtak.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What is the tentative date of the interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is 05-08-2026. Candidates should be prepared for the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job. The recruitment is for a specific period as mentioned in the official notification.
